sequence.proposed_after: A R03 migration/resume, genesis publication and ACK, seed publication/readback, and A PostgreSQL shutdown

source.copy_rule: Copy exact bytes into the approved private B root and verify the same byte count and digest; never parse/reserialize or substitute an example.

umf_access.qualification: selected current public UMF 0.5.5 access wheel; B-specific offline compatibility and runtime receipt are pending

weft_sql.scope: pinned runtime cohort; not used for B source installation

runtime_and_wheels.runtime_rebind_required: The R3 receipt is historical and records access 0.1.0.dev6, not the selected B dev7 cohort. Before execution, perform B-specific offline compatibility checks for dev7, resolve exact wheels into the proposed B venv, and generate a B-specific runtime receipt. The R3 receipt and venv are not B installation evidence.

truss_socket_and_port.port_policy: Exclusive shared-port slot only after Arras/A PostgreSQL is stopped; no concurrent LocalPostgres process. The current packet inventory is not an OS lock.
truss_socket_and_port.truss_socket_directory_algorithm: Truss 0.0.49 derives the per-data-directory socket child as /private/tmp/truss-pg18-<uid>/<first-24-hex-of-SHA256(os.fsencode(canonical_pgdata_path))>.

preflight_predicates: Exact source and origin bytes still match the pinned lengths and SHA-256; B source copy is byte-identical.
B origin has a separate explicit owner approval record; this proposal itself is not approval.
B runtime is a newly verified isolated environment with the exact selected wheel/runtime hashes and a B-specific receipt.

The root, PGDATA, attempt, evidence, source-copy and derived socket paths are canonical, user-owned, private, non-symlink paths; the proposed root and all children do not exist before one-use creation.
PGDATA is fresh and empty; no path aliases A, prior B, any retained source installation, or an unrelated PostgreSQL data directory.
Truss-computed socket child is absent; its parent is the expected private user-owned runtime root.

The exclusive window is explicitly released after A/Arras shutdown; bounded read-only process/socket inventory finds no PostgreSQL process or nominal 5432 socket, and the gate is rechecked immediately before launch and after shutdown.
Owner approves the exact B role names, consumer ID, request key, expected empty-catalog revision/document set, resource bounds and retention custodian.
One attempt only; any uncertain settlement preserves B PGDATA/logs and the original request for reconciliation. No retry, path replacement or cleanup after initialization/transaction uncertainty.

Approve unique B identities and the proposed private paths, or supply replacements; verify no collision immediately before use.
Name the B retention custodian and approve the one-attempt resource/deadline limits.

Approve a dedicated exclusive 5432 window after A/Arras has stopped and authorize one local PostgreSQL initialization plus one installation, source-acceptance and genesis-consumer-registration sequence.
